verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents generating and retrieving branded monthly account statements, and has a guide for creating and filing a 1099-INT for an account. Both paper obligations are first-party capabilities, but the evidence does not show statements being produced automatically each month or 1099-INTs being retrievable through the API. missing for 10: evidence of automatic monthly statement generation, API retrieval of 1099-INT documents, endpoint-level detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the paper obligations are automated — monthly statements generated per account, and tax documents (1099-INT) produced and retrievable through the API

citations.quote: Generate and retrieve branded monthly account statements for your customers.
This guide describes how to create and file a 1099-INT for an account.
